Conservative CIFAR-10 initial policy: standard crop/flip invariances with mild color and blur perturbations; avoids vertical flips.
Compact CIFAR-10 prior: emphasize crop/flip plus mild color and blur; avoid vertical flips and overly destructive transforms for low-data training.

Crossover of strongest compact parents: keep standard crop/flip, add low-probability erasing from the best ranked policy, and retain mild mixup/cutmix signal while avoiding heavier multi-op geometric/color chains that underperformed.

Conservative mutation combining the strongest compact crop/flip/erasing prior with mild mixup signal from the baseline reference; keeps color weak and avoids vertical flips or heavy geometric transforms for low-data CIFAR-10.

Mutation from the strongest compact policies: keep CIFAR-10 crop/flip prior, add only mild erasing and light color jitter, and use modest mixed-sample regularization informed by the strong mixup/cutmix baselines without the heavier multi-op distortions.

Compact crossover emphasizing the strongest shared CIFAR-10 prior: moderate crop/flip, light erasing, and mild sample mixing. Keeps color perturbation very small and avoids vertical flips or heavy geometric/color transforms seen in weaker complex parents.

Mutates the strongest compact erasing policy toward the external standard_mixup signal: retain crop/flip and mild erasing, add very light color jitter, and introduce modest mixup with small cutmix for low-data regularization without heavy geometric distortion.

Conservative mutation combining the strongest in-population erasing prior with the external standard_mixup signal: keep standard crop/flip, slightly reduce crop strength, retain mild erasing, add low-probability color jitter, and use modest mixup without cutmix to improve low-data macro-F1 while controlling distortion.

Crossover of the strongest compact policies: preserve CIFAR-10 crop/flip and light erasing, keep color jitter weaker than the poorer standard_color lineage, and shift sample mixing toward mixup based on the baseline reference while retaining only a small cutmix component from the best crossover.

Conservative ranked mutation from the strongest compact policies: keep the reliable CIFAR-10 crop/flip backbone and light erasing, reduce cutmix relative to the best crossover because the external reference favors mixup, and add only very mild color jitter as a secondary branch to avoid over-distortion in low-data training.

Mutation from the strongest compact crop/flip/erasing policies, shifted toward the external standard_mixup signal: keep CIFAR-10-safe crop and flip, retain light erasing, reduce cutmix versus the top crossover, and use slightly stronger mixup for low-data macro-F1 while keeping color rare and mild.

Crossover of the strongest compact parents: preserve moderate RandomCrop plus HorizontalFlip, keep light RandomErasing from the best erasing-derived policies, retain only weak ColorJitter, and shift sample mixing toward mixup because the external standard_mixup reference is strongest while cutmix appears useful only mildly. Avoids vertical flips and heavier geometric/blur transforms from weaker complex policies.

Mutation from the strongest compact crop/flip/erasing policies, shifted toward the external standard_mixup signal: keep moderate CIFAR-10 crop and horizontal flip, retain light erasing, make color jitter rare and mild, and reduce cutmix to a small auxiliary value so sample mixing improves low-data F1 without adding much distortion.

Conservative gen02 mutation: preserve the strongest compact crop/flip prior, keep light erasing but soften it slightly, reduce cutmix relative to the best crossover, and lean toward the external standard_mixup signal which has the best reference accuracy/F1. Color remains low-probability and weak to avoid over-distortion in low-data CIFAR-10.

Mutation from the strongest compact crop/flip/erasing policies, shifted toward the external standard_mixup signal: keep moderate CIFAR-10 crop and horizontal flip, retain light erasing, make color jitter rare and mild, and reduce cutmix to a small auxiliary value so sample mixing improves low-data F1 without adding much distortion.

Compact crossover emphasizing the strongest shared CIFAR-10 prior: moderate crop/flip, light erasing, and mild sample mixing. Keeps color perturbation very small and avoids vertical flips or heavy geometric/color transforms seen in weaker complex parents.

Conservative mutation combining the strongest compact crop/flip/erasing prior with mild mixup signal from the baseline reference; keeps color weak and avoids vertical flips or heavy geometric transforms for low-data CIFAR-10.

Conservative CIFAR-10 initial policy: geometry-preserving crops/flips with light color and blur regularization; avoids vertical flips.
Conservative CIFAR-10 initial policy emphasizing translation/scale invariance, mild color robustness, and occlusion regularization while avoiding vertical flips.

Crossover keeps the strongest baseline prior from standard_mixup and the best ranked parents: mild crop/flip with light color regularization. Drops stacked CutMix+Mixup and heavier blur/erasing/affine branches from complex parents because evidence favors simple Mixup over CutMix and weak parents show erasing/color-only variants underperform.

Mutation biased toward the strongest baseline prior, standard_mixup: keep mild CIFAR-safe crop/flip and a single sample-mixing mechanism, reduce over-complex stacked policies, and add only light color plus low-probability erasing for low-data robustness.

Mutation biased toward the strongest baseline_reference standard_mixup: keep mild RandomCrop/HorizontalFlip and single sample-mixing mechanism, add only light low-probability color and erasing regularization while dropping heavier dual-mixing/geometry stacks from complex parents.

Crossover keeps the strongest baseline prior from standard_mixup: mild RandomCrop plus HorizontalFlip with a single Mixup mechanism. It borrows only conservative color/rotation cues from stronger openai parents while dropping stacked CutMix, heavy multi-branch complexity, erasing, blur, affine, solarize, and discouraged flips.

Mutation from the strongest initial policies toward the baseline-supported standard_mixup prior: retain mild crop/flip geometry and light color robustness, remove stacked CutMix, and reduce high-complexity distortions for low-data CIFAR-10 generalisation.

Mutation from the strongest openai initial policies and the standard_mixup baseline prior: keeps CIFAR-10-safe crop/flip invariance, removes stacked CutMix, lowers policy complexity, and uses only light color/rotation/erasing regularization for low-data generalisation.

Crossover preserves the best baseline prior, standard_mixup, and the strongest gen01 parents: standard RandomCrop plus HorizontalFlip with one Mixup mechanism. It keeps only mild color and rotation regularization, slightly increasing Mixup from 0.22 toward the baseline while avoiding CutMix stacking, erasing, blur, affine, solarize, and vertical flips that were associated with weaker or overly complex parents.

Mutation of the strongest crossover guided by the baseline_reference: standard_mixup is the strongest prior, so keep a single Mixup mechanism and mild CIFAR-10 crop/flip. Slightly increase Mixup over gen01_cross_000 toward the baseline signal, reduce color jitter to avoid the weak standard_color pattern, and retain only very light rotation as a secondary invariance. Avoids CutMix stacking, erasing, blur, affine, solarize, and vertical flips for low-data generalisation.

Mutation from the strongest crossover and standard_mixup prior: keep simple RandomCrop+HorizontalFlip with single Mixup, slightly increase Mixup toward the baseline reference, and soften auxiliary color/rotation to reduce low-data distortion. Avoids CutMix stacking, erasing, blur, affine, solarize, and vertical flips.

Crossover preserves the strongest standard_mixup prior and the best gen01 child structure: deterministic mild RandomCrop, HorizontalFlip, light ColorJitter, and a small Rotation branch. It slightly increases Mixup from the strongest child toward the baseline_reference winner while avoiding CutMix stacking, erasing, blur, affine, solarize, and vertical flips seen in weaker or overly complex parents.

Mutation from the strongest compact Mixup policy, using standard_mixup as the main prior. Keeps crop/flip and single sample-mixing, slightly strengthens Mixup toward the best baseline, trims rotation probability, and adds only very light color jitter to improve robustness without the heavier CutMix, erasing, blur, affine, or multi-branch complexity seen in weaker evidence.

Mutation from the strongest gen01 crossover and standard_mixup prior: preserve mild crop/flip plus single Mixup, slightly strengthen Mixup toward the best baseline, reduce color jitter probability to avoid low-data over-distortion, and keep only a very light rotation cue. Avoids CutMix stacking, erasing, blur, affine, solarize, and vertical flips.

Mutation from the strongest compact Mixup policy, using standard_mixup as the main prior. Keeps crop/flip and single sample-mixing, slightly strengthens Mixup toward the best baseline, trims rotation probability, and adds only very light color jitter to improve robustness without the heavier CutMix, erasing, blur, affine, or multi-branch complexity seen in weaker evidence.

Crossover keeps the strongest baseline prior from standard_mixup and the best ranked parents: mild crop/flip with light color regularization. Drops stacked CutMix+Mixup and heavier blur/erasing/affine branches from complex parents because evidence favors simple Mixup over CutMix and weak parents show erasing/color-only variants underperform.
